answer.summary: Docker build fails in the Maven step for openaev-es8-client: Maven cannot resolve co.elastic.clients:elasticsearch-java:8.19.25, the version Renovate just bumped. It is not found in central or jboss-public, and a shibboleth-releases prefix rule blocks the path. The version may not be published, or the repository mirror may be misconfigured. Either way the error is deterministic and will repeat on re-run, though the log alone does not show which cause it is.
